# Simple health check script for services on ports 3000 and 8080
# Exits with code 0 if all services are healthy, 1 otherwise.

# Configuration
HOST="127.0.0.1"
PORTS=(3000 8080)
TIMEOUT_SECONDS=3

  local host="$1"
  local port="$2"

  # Try curl first (common on most systems)
  if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    curl --silent --max-time "${TIMEOUT_SECONDS}" "http://${host}:${port}" >/dev/null 2>&1
    return $?

  # Fallback to nc (netcat) if available
  if command -v nc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    nc -z -w "${TIMEOUT_SECONDS}" "${host}" "${port}" >/dev/null 2>&1
    return $?
  fi

  echo "[ERROR] Neither curl nor nc (netcat) is available to perform health checks." >&2
  return 2
}

all_healthy=true

for port in "${PORTS[@]}"; do
  if check_port "$HOST" "$port"; then
    echo "[OK] Service on ${HOST}:${port} is responding."
  else
    echo "[FAIL] Service on ${HOST}:${port} is NOT responding."
    all_healthy=false
  fi

done

if [ "$all_healthy" = true ]; then
  exit 0
else
  exit 1
fi
